theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : Set (Euclid n)) (R η : ℝ), MeasurableSet P → P ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → 0 < η → ∃ ψ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ ψ z ∧ ψ z ≤ 1) ∧ ∫ z, |ψ z - P.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z| < η
